recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if the work group decides that Device should remove even the compact examples; that would be a new wording choice rather than required completion of FHIR-47905.
issue_request: FHIR-47905 was Applied with a Persuasive with Modification resolution. The issue challenged a DeviceDefinition device subdivision list that was not clearly related to DeviceDefinition and duplicated a long Device list; the approved outcome was to put the combined detailed list in DeviceDefinition and have Device text refer to DeviceDefinition for device kinds/categories.
initial_application: Commit 3cf635fa2b606d038462a683a53338e39b3f30e3 explicitly listed FHIR-47905 and moved the detailed category subsections out of source/device/device-introduction.xml while adding a Device-to-DeviceDefinition category-description reference. The same commit placed the detailed category descriptions in source/devicedefinition/devicedefinition-introduction.xml; commit 0d559917d48c69ce6b362625246e95407e103b2d later corrected a typo in the Device reference sentence.
additional_context: FHIR-47904 is the same Scope and Usage wording family and later refined the DeviceDefinition opening in PR #3667. Confluence OO/DEV minutes confirm the joint discussion, the decision to move device categories into DeviceDefinition, and the 11-0-4 vote. Device and DeviceDefinition are active resources in source/fhir.ini.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The current Device page has only a compact category summary and a link to DeviceDefinition for detailed category descriptions, while the current DeviceDefinition page contains the detailed category list and definitions. No source change is needed for FHIR-47905.

related_jiras.note: Resolved to rework the DeviceDefinition Scope and Usage opening in light of FHIR-47905; the current source includes its later PR #3667 refinement.
